We offer a return window depending on the category of your items:

Stainless steel cookware: 60 days without condition on their new state.
Ceramic products, cast iron, accessories, and maintenance products: 15 days, provided they are new, unused, and in their original packaging.
Knives: 10 days, provided they are new, unused, and in their original packaging.

Return shipping is free for all customers located in continental Europe. To initiate a return, please request a return label via our dedicated portal at https://atmakitchenware.fr/a/return using your order number.

Once we receive and inspect your returned package at our warehouse, your refund will be automatically credited to your original payment method 🙂.
